note: H167. idscope.py v3 printed one ROWLESS total and declared it ungateable because "the floor is other lanes' rows". The floor was 14 NAMED ids on 2026-08-18; the sentence is now asserted over a set that has gained 10 and cleared 5, and it merges the CLAIM-only population that §2 SELECT creates on purpose with the DONE population that is terminal.

controls.name: baseline_extracted_not_retyped
controls.must_fire_because: the comparison must use the numbers v3 published, not mine
controls.can_fail_because: the v3 changelog sentence names no ids, or was edited away -- the extractor then raises rather than comparing against an empty set
controls.null_must_contain: ids that are NO LONGER rowless. The v3 set names G43/H86/H88/H89/H93, all filed since, so the extractor demonstrably reads the PUBLISHED past and not the live present -- if it could only ever return today's set the comparison would be with itself

controls.name: terminal_population_is_separable
controls.must_fire_because: the merged count is only a defect if the two populations differ in kind, so both must be non-empty and disjoint
controls.can_fail_because: every rowless id is CLAIM-only, or every one is DONE -- then there is nothing to split and v3 merged nothing
controls.null_must_contain: an empty side. A log of only CLAIM lines yields done=0 and a log of only DONE lines yields claim=0; both are reachable from the same reader, so a non-empty split is a measurement and not a property of the code

controls.name: gate_fires_and_is_scoped
controls.must_fire_because: the v4 gate must refuse an id THIS tree introduces and stay quiet on an accumulated one, or it is decoration
controls.can_fail_because: both arms return the same exit code -- a gate that cannot distinguish them has not read the property it claims to
controls.null_must_contain: both exit codes from the SAME fixture id. H99 is driven three ways and the only thing varying is the property under test, so the outcome space contains 0 and 1 by construction rather than by which id was chosen

falsifiers.name: F1_already_mechanised
falsifiers.can_fail_because: a grep of spikes/harness for a pinned rowless baseline returns a module other than idscope
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a non-idscope hit. The same grep pattern returns refcheck.py for BASELINE_ROW_SHAPE when widened to row shape, so the search can find another module -- it does not find one for THIS subject
falsifiers.detail: other modules pinning a rowless baseline: none
falsifiers.refutes: refutes the finding: another checker already pins a rowless baseline or branches its verdict on CLAIM vs DONE
falsifiers.fires_when: a grep of spikes/harness for a pinned rowless baseline returns a module other than idscope
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_no_decay
falsifiers.null_must_contain: equality. The two sets share 9 members, so the comparison is not structurally forced apart -- had the 15 gained ids never landed it would report equal
falsifiers.refutes: refutes the finding: the live set equals the 14 v3 named, so the sentence is still true and a bare count is fine
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_sanctioned_workflow_refused
falsifiers.can_fail_because: scan() returns non-zero on a CLAIM-only rowless id
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a refusal. The same scan() returns 1 on the same id posted as DONE, so non-zero is reachable on this fixture and the quiet verdict is about CLAIM, not about a gate that never fires
falsifiers.detail: CLAIM-only exit=0 with 11 live CLAIM-only ids
falsifiers.refutes: refutes the FIX: a lane obeying §2 SELECT (post CLAIM before the row exists) is gated, which recreates H52
falsifiers.fires_when: scan() returns non-zero on a CLAIM-only rowless id
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F4_incoming_unclearable
falsifiers.can_fail_because: every terminal id was introduced by a commit that already carried WORK_QUEUE.md, leaving its author no cheaper moment to file the row
falsifiers.null_must_contain: commits that DID carry it. G45 and H76 are exactly that case, so the measurement can produce the refuting answer and 8/13 is an observation rather than a definition
falsifiers.detail: 8 of 13 introduced without the authoritative file
falsifiers.refutes: refutes the FIX: the incoming ids are unclearable for the same reason the floor is, so gating them is H52 again
falsifiers.fires_when: every terminal id was introduced by a commit that already carried WORK_QUEUE.md, leaving its author no cheaper moment to file the row
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: If the live rowless set still equalled the 14 ids v3 named (F2), or if a CLAIM-only id were gated by the fix (F3), or if every terminal id had been introduced by a commit already carrying WORK_QUEUE.md (F4), the finding or the fix would be refuted.
